name: GG & Joe
notes: Items and descriptions from the menu page on the cafe's own website; prices from the PDF menu linked on that page. Drinks sold in several sizes show the smallest price, with every size price in the description (the PDF does not name the sizes). Fall seasonal drinks, Strawberry Glow, pastries and vegan treats are on the website but not priced in the PDF, so they have no price. The address was wrong on the old page (150 Post Rd E); the cafe is at 165 Main St. Phone and hours from the website.
